name: Bolivia

fees.name: Visa de Turismo (consulate-issued)
fees.applies: Group II/III nationalities requiring a visa (Group I is visa-exempt)
fees.notes: Official consular tariff (Resolucion Ministerial 081, 13 Apr 2015): 'Visas de Turismo, conforme a normativa vigente y reciprocidad' USD 30. The former USD 160 sticker tourist visa for US/Puerto Rico citizens is obsolete: US citizens are visa-exempt since 1 Dec 2025 (Decreto Supremo 5497).

fees.name: Tourist visa on arrival (border/airport, Group II)
fees.applies: Group II nationalities eligible for visa on arrival
fees.notes: Third-party sources widely cite ~USD 95 (BOB 665) paid in cash at the border, vs USD 30 at a consulate, but no current official published amount could be verified; some reports say VOA availability changed in mid-2025. Amount left null per accuracy rules.

fees.name: Visa Multiple (business and investment, multiple entry, 1 year)
fees.notes: Official consular tariff. Related 'Visa de Objeto Determinado' (work/health/family) is USD 85.

fees.name: Visa en Transito
fees.notes: Listed as gratuito (no charge) in the official consular tariff.

reciprocity_variations.note: Visa-exempt (Group I) since 1 Dec 2025 under Decreto Supremo 5497; previously a USD 160 sticker visa applied. 90-day visa-free stay.
Group I visa-exempt for tourism (up to 90 days per year); no fee.
Group II: tourist visa required, USD 30 at a consulate per official tariff; visa on arrival at higher unverified cost may be available.
Visa required with prior authorisation for Group III nationalities; consular fee USD 30 per official tariff. Group assignment should be confirmed with the consulate.

free_visa_notes: Group I nationalities (incl. US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, NZ, Russia; expanded 1 Dec 2025 by Decreto Supremo 5497 to add USA, South Korea, Israel, UAE and others) enter visa-free for tourism up to 90 days per year. Transit visa is free of charge for all.
